headline: Billie Eilish Named As Glastonbury 2027 Headliner And BST Performer
seoTitle: Billie Eilish To Headline Glastonbury 2027 And BST Hyde Park
metaDescription: Billie Eilish has been confirmed as a headliner for Glastonbury Festival 2027 and will also perform a headline set at London's BST Hyde Park in July.
aiSummaryBullets: Billie Eilish has been officially confirmed as one of the headline acts for the Glastonbury Festival in 2027.
The performer is also scheduled to headline an event at BST Hyde Park in London on July 3.
The Glastonbury 2027 lineup also includes performances from Harry Styles, Cher, and Sam Fender.
aiContextParagraph: The upcoming Glastonbury Festival 2027 is set to feature a diverse roster of musical acts following recent official announcements. Among the confirmed headliners for the festival are Billie Eilish, Harry Styles, Cher, and Sam Fender. In addition to her scheduled appearance at Glastonbury, Billie Eilish has been announced as a headliner for the BST Hyde Park concert series in London, with her performance there slated for July 3. This announcement follows the reveal of other BST Hyde Park headliners, including RAYE and Bon Jovi, adding to the city's summer live music schedule. The news regarding Eilish's dual headline commitments provides clarity on her touring plans for the 2027 season, following the high-profile reveal of the main stage acts for Glastonbury, which continues to be a major highlight of the United Kingdom's annual music calendar.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two major independent outlets, indicating widespread interest in the 2027 festival circuit and major artist tour schedules.
